authorised_by: THE USER, explicitly. The architect is gate owner and reviewer, not approver.

does_not_rewrite.statement: This amendment is ADDITIVE and stands BESIDE the J4 recovery-only amendment. It rewrites nothing: v26c_j3_amendment_recovery_only.json keeps its own text, its own hash and its own scope.

authorises.scope: ONE fresh deterministic closed-loop REVALIDATION of the J4 recovery product
permitted: ONE deterministic closed-loop rollout of the pinned J4 recovery actor under the pinned v3 runtime
writing a fresh J5 trace, kinematics, sim_outputs and receipt in a new no-clobber leaf
forbidden: retry of J3, J4 or J5
any further fit, optimizer step, DAgger round or progressive recovery iteration
sigma or exploration noise of any kind
using July artefacts as operational parents, datasets or labels
modifying any content-addressed J0-J4 artefact or script
authorises.promotion_policy: a J5 PASS confers NO promotion, NO deployability and NO authorisation of any next stage. Those remain separate, explicitly authorised decisions.

operational_actor.statement: the J4 recovery checkpoint is the ONLY actor J5 may roll out. It is the same single 35D student, not a new one, and it is not widened.
operational_actor.why_the_mask_differs_from_j3: the base stages J2/J3 hard-zeroed the clock AND the controller memory. The recovery stage lifted the ten controller-memory columns, as attested by the J4 receipt, so at J5 only the clock stays hard-zero. The actor width is unchanged.

runtime.action_selection: deterministic mean; no sigma, no exploration noise
runtime.stepped_with: the RAW deterministic action; the clipped action stays a diagnostic mirror

gates.statement: EXACTLY the J3 gates, inherited verbatim. No threshold is added, moved, relaxed or reinterpreted.
gates.telemetry_integrity: the same HS/TO self-consistency invariant, recorded separately and never a behavioural threshold

comparisons_required.rule: REPORTED as evidence only. A comparison never becomes a gate, never reinterprets a threshold and never excuses a FAIL.

outcome_policy.pass_condition: every J3 gate passes AND the telemetry integrity invariant holds

immutability: this file is content-addressed by the artefacts it pins. Any change to a pinned artefact invalidates it. It is never edited in place, and it never edits the J4 amendment.
